Players Committee card image of [[Taidu Sefla]] (original printing), game text: “When deployed (or just lost), may draw bottom card of Used Pile. During battle, may subtract X (limit 3) from a just drawn weapon or battle destiny, where X = number of your spies out of play. Your spies here are immune to Nevar Yalnal.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/taidusefla.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
